entry.name: openGroupingStrategy
entry.label: Grouping strategy for open windows: 0 = No grouping, 1 = Compact window list popup, 2 = Present Windows (Exposé) effect, 3 = Bring application to foreground

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentScreen
entry.label: Whether to show only tasks on the current screen.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentDesktop
entry.label: Whether to show only tasks on the current virtual desktop.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentActivity
entry.label: Whether to show only tasks on the current activity.

entry.name: minimizeActiveTaskOnClick
entry.label: Whether clicking the currently active task minimizes it.

entry.name: middleClickAction
entry.label: Middle click action: 0 = Close, 1 = ToggleMinimized, 2 = NewInstance

entry.name: pushMinimizedToRight
entry.label: Whether to push minimized windows to the right side of the panel with a spacer.

entry.name: reverseMinimized
entry.label: Whether minimized windows flow from right to left.

entry.name: maxTaskWidth
entry.label: Maximum width for open task buttons.

entry.name: minTaskWidth
entry.label: Minimum width for open task buttons (buttons shrink to this before clipping).

entry.name: dimMinimizedIcons
entry.label: Whether to slightly dim minimized icons until hovered.

entry.name: showToolTips
entry.label: Whether to show tooltips when hovering task buttons.
